requirements.assertion: A nonzero unitless CSS x declaration on a rect is invalid and ignored; with no other valid overriding declaration, the valid x presentation attribute remains effective.
requirements.subject: user-agent
requirements.rationale: Narrow legacy-2018 compatibility mapping only, not a claim about the complete current SVG2 audit or general cascading. The named literal fixtures have independently constructed 16x16 RGBA references and passed strict zero-difference native comparisons on source 5b2f9a185e1fb06bba752878a715fa57adc6800d. SVG2 2018 defines x as length-percentage, separates presentation-attribute number syntax and CSS syntax, and assigns presentation attributes specificity zero. Its bibliography cites CSS Values 3 dated 2018-08-14. The source_text_hash covers normalized text from the listed support passages in their listed order.

requirements.assertion: With no other x declarations, inline x:.0 is a valid zero length that overrides x="4" on a rect.
